description: A Dart class 'AppEnv' that manages application environment variables for a Flutter app, including loading environment variables and providing accessors for config values like API URLs and feature flags.

classes.name: AppEnv
classes.description: A utility class for loading and accessing environment variables in a Flutter application.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads environment variables from a specified file, with error handling and fallback.

methods.name: apiBaseUrl
methods.description: Getter for the backend API base URL, with a default fallback.

methods.name: websocketUrl
methods.description: Getter for the WebSocket URL, with a default fallback.

methods.name: featureUseLocalDb
methods.description: Boolean getter indicating if the app should use a local database, based on environment variables.
